**Connecting New Year's and Movies**

I'm considering how to connect the concept of "Black date" with New Year's Eve. I think about the movie "Deadpool," which ties in themes of death. The phrase "Day of the dead" feels like a rejection in this context. Then there's the idea of combining A10 and B7 to form a movie title or brand, possibly like "Event Horizon." I find it intriguing how events and titles can intertwine!
